focus: the new Projectile.Launch prefix (equipment swap and unique-weapon trait re-application) and the Fire/OrderAttack changes
diffSource: since build 2 (2026-10-06T16:38:17Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: OrderAttack clears the warmup before the base can reject the order
findings.detail: Building_WeaponMount.OrderAttack sets fireReadyTick = -1 whenever targ != forcedTarget, then calls base. Building_TurretGun.OrderAttack can still turn the order down: below minimum range or beyond maximum range it posts a message and returns without changing forcedTarget, and an invalid targ only clears the forced target. In those cases a warmup that was nearly finished is lost and BeginBurst starts a full warmup again on the same target. Save forcedTarget before calling base.OrderAttack(targ) and reset fireReadyTick only if forcedTarget is different afterwards.

findings.title: Patch targets are not in the Schematic
findings.detail: verify_patches reports that ShotReport.HitFactorFromShooter and Projectile.Launch are not in the Schematic. Running update_schematic adds them if the patches are meant to stay. This does not affect players.

findings.title: This mod's Circinus error classes were not checked
findings.detail: pyxis_mod_errors refused to run because no Pyxis token is configured. Adding one in Settings → Integrations lets the check run. Nothing here confirms or rules out an existing class in the changed code.
